name: Andy W
text: Excellent job sorting out my very overgrown garden. The team worked really hard on a very cold day. The garden hasn’t looked this good since before we moved in. Found some parts of the garden we didn’t know we had. Definitely recommended. Thanks.
notes: Submitted through the website review form on 13/11/2026. Contact details, if any were given, are in the Netlify Forms inbox. Not shown on the site until the tick box at the top is switched on.
